about.title: IDEAS WITHOUT BORDERS
about.description: The International Week of Innovative Ideas — “Innoweek.uz” has been held since 2018 with the aim of accelerating innovative development in the republic, widely implementing innovations and technologies in all sectors of the economy, developing human capital, science and innovation. Over the past period, it has developed under the leadership of President Shavkat Mirziyoyev and has become the largest platform in Central Asia for demonstrating advanced innovations and developing global cooperation. The event annually brings together leading local and international companies, investors, diplomats, entrepreneurs, scientists, startups, technology experts and representatives of government agencies. It is also an ideal platform for communicating with leaders of the innovation sector, stakeholders in the field of cooperation and investment.

items.question: What is the main goal of the event?
items.answer: The main goal of InnoWeek is to promote innovative ideas, scientific developments, and technologies in Uzbekistan, strengthen international cooperation, and support young innovators.

items.question: Which innovative developments or projects will be presented?
items.answer: nnovative projects in artificial intelligence, digital transformation, biotechnology, green energy, and industrial engineering will be showcased.

items.question: What opportunities are provided for youth and students?
items.answer: Youth and students can participate in startup competitions, masterclasses, training sessions, and meetings with potential investors.

items.question: How to get to CAEx?
items.answer: To ensure convenient access to the “InnoWeek-2025” event, taking place from October 9–11, 2025, the Ministry of Higher Education, Science and Innovation will provide free shuttle buses from the “Uzbekistan” Hotel and “Do‘stlik” metro station to the “CAEx Uzbekistan” exhibition complex.

items.question: Are there any restaurants or cafes near CAEx?
items.answer: Food and beverage services will be available inside the exhibition pavilion, including local restaurants and cafes.

items.question: Where will the forums of “InnoWeek-2025” take place?
items.answer: All events and forums scheduled within the framework of “InnoWeek-2025” will be held on the CAEx premises. You can view the full program via the link (....), or through special digital displays during the event.

expert_feedback.feedback_1_desc: “InnoWeek 2024 became a true platform for global dialogue. It’s not just about ideas here — it’s about real solutions that can be scaled across the region.”
expert_feedback.feedback_2_desc: “I was impressed by the openness of Uzbekistan’s innovation ecosystem. InnoWeek showcased outstanding organization and strategic thinking in both scientific and applied development fields.”
expert_feedback.feedback_3_desc: “The focus on sustainability and youth-led startups at InnoWeek 2024 was truly inspiring. Uzbekistan is showing how a government can be a reliable partner for innovative business.”
expert_feedback.feedback_4_desc: “InnoWeek in Tashkent is not just an exhibition — it’s a strategic gateway to the Central Asian market. You can feel the energy of growth and huge potential for international collaboration.”
